name: front plank with arm lift
description: A plank where one arm lifts at a time, challenging core stability and anti-rotation.
instructions: Set up in a forearm plank with elbows under shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lift one arm forward without letting your hips twist.
Return it and lift the other arm.
Alternate in a slow, controlled rhythm.
